requirements.rule: Art. 34 cc. 3 and 7: the engine pays the level-specific allowances only while the caller states the qualifying roles. It cannot independently verify a child's age or certification validity, written notice and delivery of its copy. Nor does it automatically offset the allowance of c. 3 against an individual superminimo or that of c. 7 against better treatment received overall; the caller must state individual pay net of any offset. The c. 4 allowance is restricted to C super and D super, outside this reduced-hours file.
requirements.remediation: Verify role eligibility externally and state individual pay net of any offset; to automate this, model child age, certification validity and notice, and the applicable offsets.

requirements.rule: NOT MODELLED: students aged 16 to 40 (art. 14 c. 2) at levels other than C, B and B super, for whom Tabella B has no value. The 2026 monthly allowances of Tables H (BS, 97.06) and L (B and BS, 30.27) are encoded for caller-attested eligible roles; child age, certification validity and absorption by better individual pay cannot be inferred from the role alone.
requirements.remediation: Source the Tabella B values for the other student levels. For modeled levels, supply eligible roles only after checking child age, certification conditions and any offset against individual pay.
